instructions: A pi extension loaded straight from TypeScript source; there is no build step. It shells out to the herdr CLI and parses its JSON output.

rules.rule: @earendil-works/* packages stay in peerDependencies with the "*" range and must never appear in dependencies: pi supplies them, and a bundled copy breaks its module mapping.
The extension must stay a single file with no relative imports: users can symlink it into ~/.pi/agent/extensions, and pi resolves imports from the symlink's location.
